snippet.title: Silly Souls — Release Date Trailer | Coming October 15, 2026
snippet.description:
Your friends. One Reaper. Four maps of chaos. 👻

Silly Souls is coming October 15, 2026! Grab your friends for 2–8 player multiplayer chaos across 4 maps.

Wishlist on Steam now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5292680/Silly_Souls/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=silly_souls&utm_content=trailer

Join our Discord for updates, suggestions, and bug reports:
https://discord.gg/AMzSFdnKr

Suggestions and bug reports can also be sent to SillySouls.support@gmail.com.

Pasta Desert Studios:
https://pastadesertstudios.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_content=trailer

#SillySouls #IndieGame #HorrorGaming
